audience: delivery and logistics teams that dispatch couriers through Nash

useCases.title: Track deliveries in transit
useCases.text: List jobs by date, delivery status or provider. Open one job to read its courier and tracking data.

useCases.title: Find a delivery by your own identifier
useCases.text: Get a job by the external identifier your system set when it created the job. Read its status and courier.

useCases.title: Find orders that have no delivery yet
useCases.text: List orders with filters and sorting. Then read one order's pickup, drop-off details and quotes.

useCases.title: Review routes and zones
useCases.text: List the multi-stop routes, then read one route's stops and travel metrics. List the delivery zones of the organization.

useCases.title: Create an order and compare quotes
useCases.text: Create a pre-dispatch order, or update it by its external id. It returns priced quotes and dispatches no courier.
